title: Full and Open Competition, Fabrication for Transportation Frame.
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE NAVY.ONR.ONR NRL.NAVAL RESEARCH LABORATORY
description_text: Contractors must be certified through Defense Logistics Information Services’ (DLIS) Joint Certification Program in order to access Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) or Export Controlled information in Contract Opportunities. See the DLA website for the Joint Certification Program: https://www.dla.mil/HQ/LogisticsOperations/Services/JCP/. The Naval Research Laboratory’s Tactical Electronic Warfare Division, Code 5700, has a requirement for the procurement of FFabrications of Aluminum parts for transportation frame. For additional details on the submission of quotes, please see the attached Combined Synopsis/Solicitation N00173-26-Q-1301357113A2 and Attachment 2 – Drawings, which is issued in accordance with FAR Subparts 13.5 and 12.6.
